risks.note: The MD&A lists volatility in the prices of key raw materials first among risks, and states that changes in commodity prices may adversely affect margins where such increases cannot be passed on to customers. This bit in FY 2025-26: cost of materials consumed rose while revenue grew only about 2.09%, turning a prior-year profit before tax into a loss before tax.
risks.risk: Raw-material price volatility with limited pass-through

risks.note: Regulatory and environmental requirements relating to plastic packaging are an explicitly flagged risk, and the Company warns that increasing environmental regulations and restrictions on plastics and packaging materials may require additional investment in technology, processes and product development — a structural cost on a single-material-dependent packaging business.
risks.risk: Regulatory and environmental restrictions on plastic packaging

risks.note: Management flags competitive pressures within the packaging industry, with manufacturers competing on price, quality, product innovation, technology and delivery capabilities. For a price-competitive commodity-packaging supplier this constrains the ability to recover input-cost inflation.

Changes in energy and transportation costs are listed as a distinct risk; along with other input costs they are cited as the reason FY 2025-26 operating performance remained under pressure despite higher revenue.

Both are named in the MD&A risk list. The Company carried meaningful finance costs in FY 2025-26 (down about 8.54% year on year but still a material charge against an EBITDA that nearly halved), so refinancing terms and rate moves bear directly on profitability.
risks.risk: Availability and cost of financing, and interest-rate fluctuations

risks.note: Changes in customer demand are flagged as a risk, and the MD&A adds that changes in consumer preferences, demand conditions, foreign exchange movements, interest rates and general economic conditions may affect performance. The business is concentrated on the beverage and consumer-facing end markets, so a demand shift there flows straight through.

Listed both in the MD&A ('technological changes and the need for continuous product development') and in the Directors' Report risk-management paragraph, which names technology obsolescence among the common risks. The industry shift to rPET, recyclable and lightweight packaging makes this a live re-tooling requirement rather than a generic caveat.
risks.risk: Technology obsolescence and the need for continuous product development

risks.note: The Directors' Report risk-management section names retention of talent and expansion of facilities among the Company's common risks, alongside regulations, competition, business risk and investments; business risk is stated to further include financial, political and legal risk. A Risk Management Policy was adopted during the year and is reviewed by the Audit Committee.

currentContext.expansion: The annual report discloses no named capacity-addition or commissioning project. The only forward expansion statement is a one-line intent under the Directors' Report heading 'Expansion': the Company is exploring opportunities to expand its business in other geographies of the country and outside. The material structural addition during FY 2025-26 was inorganic rather than greenfield — on 6 October 2025 the Company acquired 100% of the equity shares of Hindustan Autoplast Private Limited, which became a wholly owned (though not material) subsidiary, causing consolidated financial statements to be prepared for the year. Separately, through its related company AMD Estates & Developers Private Limited, a commercial complex at Sector-114, Gurgaon, Haryana is being developed in collaboration with VSR Infratech Private Limited, New Delhi; that project is described as almost complete, with some units already handed over or sold and the Company trying to complete the sale by the end of year 2025-26. On the organic side the narrative is maintenance and efficiency rather than expansion — the Company says it continued to focus on efficient utilisation of its existing manufacturing facilities, on improving manufacturing efficiencies, and on evaluating opportunities for process improvement, automation and technology enhancement. No commissioning dates, project capex quantum or capacity numbers are stated.
